d: - Having endured bush fires, floods, extreme temperatures, starvation, and Outback politics for 42 days, the winner will finally be revealed on this 2 hr. special.
- Immediately following the finale, Bryant Gumbel will host a LIVE gathering of the 16 survivors who will be reunited for the first time since being in the Outback.

st: The First 24 Days: A Closer Look
d: - One hour of highlights and never-before-seen footage that will recap the survivors' first 24 days in the Australian Outback.
- Heavy storms and lack of rations test the capabilities and spirit of the survivors.
- The Barramundi tribe faces hard -- and very wet -- times, on SURVIVOR.
- Mother Nature flexes her muscles in the Outback. It’s Day 32 and the survivors are being pounded by torrential rains.
- Despite their bad fortune, the survivors' spirits are lifted by the reward challenge.
- Now that the $1 million prize is within reach, the stakes are at an all-time high for the final four survivors.
